name: handshake
title: A handshake: ping, pong
summary: Two workers take turns: one says ping, the other answers pong, round after round, waiting for each other by sleeping and waking or by spinning. The time per round trip is the cost of a wake-up.

controls.name: waiting
controls.label: Waiting by
controls.hint: sleep and wake: memory.atomic.wait32 and memory.atomic.notify. spin: a loop on the word.

results.name: sleeps
results.label: Sleeps
results.what: times a worker went to sleep on a word

results.name: spins
results.label: Spins
results.what: iterations spent spinning on a word

results.name: per_round
results.label: Per round trip
results.what: the wall time divided by the round trips

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: all round trips, from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of the two workers, where a waiting worker sleeps until the other's notify
